help.Navigation description:
1–6. Swipe switcher for the main app screens.
It contains a 2×3 grid of dots that shows the current position. The active dot matches the selected screen.
help.Navigation diagram legend:
1. All tasks
2. Scheme of tasks
3. Selected day
4. Calendar
5. Selected task
6. Progress — shows stats for blocks configured to appear in statistics

7. Menu with settings, user profile, and additional app information
8. Motivation page
9. Add task
help.Add task description: The task creation interface opens by tapping the "+" icon on the right side of the navigation bar
help.Add category description:
You can add a category in two ways:

1. While creating a task, when choosing a category, tap the "Add category" button

2. On the "All tasks" screen, with the "Categories" filter selected, tap the "Add category" button
help.Add block description: Open a task and tap an empty area of the task. The block editor panel will open. In this panel you can choose the block type (text, lists, timers, counters, etc.) and other options.
help.Block types description:
• Paragraph — plain text
• Headings
• Bulleted and numbered lists
• Expandable block and expandable headings 1–4
• Timer
• Stopwatch
• Counter — numeric value with units and a goal
help.Block settings description: In block settings you can enable “Journal by day”. Then the block state (for example, a checked checkbox or a counter value) is stored separately for each day. The “Show in stats” option includes the block on the task Progress screen.
